title: GTA V Phone Notification
blurb: That iFruit buzz meant one of three men was about to ruin your afternoon. Grand Theft Auto V made the in-game phone unavoidable — missions, girlfriends, Lester with another idea — so the notification became conditioned as an interruption with consequences rather than a neutral alert. Players learned to dread it mid-heist. Use it in edits for in-game texting, or set it as a real tone and enjoy the brief sensation of being Michael declining Franklin's calls from a hillside house he cannot really afford. Los Santos, in your pocket.
origin: The in-game phone notification from Grand Theft Auto V.
